content.contents: to paddle in the wake. like doggy-paddling, idly kicking one's feet to keep afloat in the aftermath of something huge, such as, an album releasing. that's the limbo i find myself in. it's not bad or anything, in fact, the response to the album's release has been nothing short of heartwarming. the fact that there's this many people enjoying what i make, listening to something i poured my heart and soul into, it means so, so much. so, once again, thank you all for your continued support <3

i'm currently on ... RITALIN. yes, finally, your girl is on stimulants. methylphenidate hydrochloride. shit is good. helps me stay focused, though when i'm not doing something my mind craves stimulation (from any source) so bad that i feel this pain in my chest, like a nervous itch that's only scratched by some form of occupation. i was sat here idling, watching youtube, but now that feels like nothing to me, like i'm doing nothing productive. as such, i decided to write a blog.
so, what's been happening since the album released?

well... i've been adapting to multiple medications; i've been having serious mood swings thanks to a correction of my HRT dosage, and of course the ADHD meds. all the unwanted side effects do seem to be dissipating now which is nice, but for a couple weeks i was having really bizarre dreams and hot flushes in the night, waking up pooled in sweat. weird shit!
additionally, i've been working on a rather large commission that i can't share too many details of, but when the time comes you'll all definitely have a chance to hear it.

my girlfriend and i are hoping to move this year, out of this very far-right area of england. hopefully we'll head somewhere up north, there's a lot of cool music stuff going on further north anyways, so maybe that'll mean more opportunities. maybe even static.grl live gigs? :o who knows!

of course, this image is the cover of this blog, but it's also the cover of a track i posted to soundcloud, called 'Breakgore Halcyon Daze'. i wrote that track around 3 years ago. people seemed to like it which i'm pleased with, i'm hoping it'll mean people are receptive to my further pursuits into acoustic singer/songwritery stuff. i have big plans. we'll see what happens.
